# Sprezzature

> Ten open-source Python packages, each also a Claude Code / OpenCode skill: UI, CLI-to-GUI, publishing, accessibility, colours, captions and narration, Laws of UX, data-science figures, maps, and the claims a film makes. Each one both makes artifacts and audits them.

## Next step

- [Star sprezzature on GitHub](https://github.com/warith-harchaoui/sprezzature)
- [Install all ten packages with pip install sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/packages.html)
- [↓ Runnable accessibility kit (27 KB)](https://sprezzature.ai/kits/accessibility.zip)
- [↓ Runnable CLI-to-GUI kit (36 KB)](https://sprezzature.ai/kits/cli-gui.zip)

## Home

- [Sprezzature — ten Claude / OpenCode skills for vanilla JS + Tailwind](https://sprezzature.ai/): sprezzature: ten open-source Python packages and Claude Code / OpenCode skills that make and audit UI (user interface, the screens, buttons and forms a person works with), figures, maps, colours, captions and publishing.

## Skills

- [UI generation — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ui.html): Vanilla JavaScript + Tailwind UI, components, pages, forms, dialogs, dashboards, for teams shipping internal tools without a designer.
- [CLI → GUI — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/cli.html): Wrap an existing command-line tool in a one-page vanilla-JS + Tailwind GUI: it reads the argument parser and builds the exact command line.
- [Publishing — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/publish.html): Turn a folder of Markdown into a findable static site: meta tags, favicons, sitemap, llms.txt, feeds, FAQ markup, plain-language rewrites and narration.
- [Accessibility — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/accessibility.html): Static HTML accessibility lint with twenty rules decidable from source, no browser needed, plus missing alt text drafted by a local vision model.
- [Colors — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/colors.html): Colour tooling for Tailwind: WCAG contrast checks with OKLCH fixes, colour-vision-deficiency simulation, a curated palette and a config emitter.
- [Audio — captions — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/audio.html): Local-AI captions and narration: WebVTT / SRT from whisper.cpp, who spoke when with NeMo, speaker identification, and text-to-speech on your machine.
- [Laws of UX — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ux-laws.html): Apply the 30 canonical Laws of UX (Jon YABLONSKI) to vanilla-JS + Tailwind, both when building new UI and when auditing HTML that already exists.
- [Figures — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/figures.html): A rendered catalog of charts and statistical plots from sprezzature-figures: +150 hand-authored SVG chart types, all from fake data on a curated palette.
- [Video claims — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/video.html): Check what a project video says against the project itself: claims on screen verified against the code, so a stale count never outlives its catalogue.

## Case studies

- [Case studies — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/case-studies.html): Three advanced Ralph Eyeball Loop examples: a tribute to Hans ROSLING's animation, publication-grade situation maps and a markets dashboard.
- [Tribute to Hans ROSLING — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/hans-rosling.html): An animated tribute to Hans ROSLING's health-and-wealth bubble chart: every country, 1950 to 2025, in one self-contained SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics, pictures stored as drawing instructions rather than pixels, so they stay sharp at any zoom) with no JavaScript library.
- [Maps — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/maps.html): Publication-grade maps in SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics): situation maps on a Lambert projection with real relief, change maps between two dated records, and glyph maps over real French election data.
- [Financial markets — Favourable case — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/financial-markets.html): A systematic portfolio with automatic size Kₜ in ten interactive, colour-blind-safe SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics, pictures stored as drawing instructions rather than pixels, so they stay sharp at any zoom) panels. This favourable draw ends at +123% net return.
- [Financial markets — Adverse case — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/financial-markets-adverse.html): A systematic portfolio with automatic size Kₜ in ten interactive, colour-blind-safe SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics, pictures stored as drawing instructions rather than pixels, so they stay sharp at any zoom) panels. This adverse draw ends at -26% net return.

## Reference

- [Packages — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/packages.html): The ten sprezzature packages, each pip-installable with its own repo: figures, maps, colours, accessibility, CLI, UX laws, audio, publish, UI, video.
- [The Ralph Eyeball Loop — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ralph-eyeball-loop.html): You can't proofread a chart by reading its code. The Ralph Eyeball Loop renders it, looks at it, fixes what the eye catches, and goes round again.

## Films

- [Eleven short films — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/films.html): Eleven short films about sprezzature, one on the suite and one per package, where every figure, map and form on screen is real output of the tools.

## French (Français)

Every page above has a French translation at the same path under `/fr/` (e.g. `/fr/figures.html`), declared via `hreflang` on each page.
